title: Delegated-principal claims (RFC 8693)
description: The delegation claims a callee reads AFTER verifying signature and aud. Validating this shape is never a substitute for that verification: an unverified `sub` is worth less than no `sub`, because it looks like authority.

sub.description: The ORIGINATING principal — whom the work is ultimately for. This is the subject Permit decides on. Typed prefix is mandatory; a bare id cannot be resolved to a principal kind and so cannot be checked.

act.description: The actor chain, outermost first: the immediate actor, then its actor. BOUNDS what `sub` may reach and never widens it.

sub.description: A TYPED reference. An untyped actor is rejected: it cannot be matched against the callee's brokerable set, and a rule that cannot be evaluated must not be treated as satisfied.
